import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem tendsto_increment_of_tendsto_deriv
  {f : ℝ → ℝ} {h L : ℝ}
  (hh : 0 < h)
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Filter.Tendsto (deriv f) Filter.atTop (𝓝 L)) :
  Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f (x + h) - f x) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (h * L)) := by
  have h_mvt : ∀ x > 0, ∃ c ∈ Ioo x (x + h), f (x + h) - f x = h * deriv f c := by
    intro x hx
    have hx_le : x < x + h := lt_add_of_pos_right x hh
    have h_sub : Icc x (x + h) ⊆ Ioi 0 := fun y hy => lt_of_lt_of_le hx hy.1
    have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Icc x (x + h)) := (hfd.mono h_sub).continuousOn
    have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo x (x + h)) :=
      hfd.mono (subset_trans Ioo_subset_Icc_self h_sub)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hderiv⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_slope f hx_le hcont hdiff
    refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
    have hdiff_eq : x + h - x = h := by ring
    rw [hderiv, hdiff_eq, mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hh)]
  
  have H : ∀ x, ∃ y, 0 < x → y ∈ Ioo x (x + h) ∧ f (x + h) - f x = h * deriv f y := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : 0 < x
    · obtain ⟨c, hc, h_eq⟩ := h_mvt x hx
      exact ⟨c, fun _ => ⟨hc, h_eq⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨x, fun hx' => False.elim (hx hx')⟩
  
  choose c hc using H
  
  have hc_prop : ∀ x > 0, c x ∈ Ioo x (x + h) ∧ f (x + h) - f x = h * deriv f (c x) :=
    fun x hx => hc x hx
  
  have hc_gt : ∀ x > 0, x < c x := fun x hx => (hc_prop x hx).1.1
  
  have h_tendsto_c : Tendsto c atTop atTop := by
    rw [tendsto_atTop_atTop]
    intro M
    refine ⟨max (M + 1) 1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_of_max_le_right hx)
    have hxM : M + 1 ≤ x := le_of_max_le_left hx
    have : x < c x := hc_gt x hx0
    linarith
  
  have h_lim : Tendsto (fun x => h * deriv f (c x)) atTop (𝓝 (h * L)) := by
    have h_comp : Tendsto (fun x => deriv f (c x)) atTop (𝓝 L) := hf.comp h_tendsto_c
    exact h_comp.const_mul h
  
  refine h_lim.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hx
  exact (hc_prop x hx).2.symm

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem tendsto_increment_of_tendsto_deriv
  {f : ℝ → ℝ} {h L : ℝ}
  (hh : 0 < h)
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Filter.Tendsto (deriv f) Filter.atTop (𝓝 L)) :
  Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f (x + h) - f x) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (h * L)) := by
  have H : ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ c : ℝ, x < c ∧ c < x + h ∧ (0 < x → f (x + h) - f x = h * deriv f c) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : 0 < x
    · have hx_lt : x < x + h := lt_add_of_pos_right x hh
      have hsub : Icc x (x + h) ⊆ Ioi 0 := by
        intro y hy
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx hy.1
      have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Icc x (x + h)) := (hfd.mono hsub).continuousOn
      have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo x (x + h)) :=
        hfd.mono (subset_trans Ioo_subset_Icc_self hsub)
      rcases exists_deriv_eq_slope f hx_lt hcont hdiff with ⟨c, hc, hderiv⟩
      refine ⟨c, hc.1, hc.2, fun _ => ?_⟩
      have hlen : x + h - x = h := by ring
      have hne : h ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hh
      rw [hlen] at hderiv
      rw [hderiv, mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hne]
    · refine ⟨x + h / 2, by linarith, by linarith, fun h => (hx h).elim⟩
  choose c hc_gt hc_lt hc_eq using H
  have hc_tendsto : Tendsto c atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_mono (fun x => le_of_lt (hc_gt x)) tendsto_id
  have hcomp : Tendsto (fun x => deriv f (c x)) atTop (𝓝 L) :=
    hf.comp hc_tendsto
  have hmul : Tendsto (fun x => h * deriv f (c x)) atTop (𝓝 (h * L)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.mul hcomp
  refine (tendsto_congr' ?_).mp hmul
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x hx
  exact (hc_eq x hx).symm
